Public Sans, the USWDS face. The one rule doing real work: monospace marks a string you transcribe exactly. Accessions, rsIDs, concept ids, predicate names and tool names qualify. Gene symbols, disease names, evidence kinds and licences do not, because they are read as words and mono makes a sentence stutter. Decided 2026-08-12.
